ABSENCE: no test exercises the recheck exclusion against a record whose `spec` differs from its `solver_id`, so the coupling is unguarded.
advisory.finding: In `recheck_recorded`, recorded rows are excluded by matching `r.get("spec")` (the record's prompt-id field) against `POLARITY_FREE_SOLVERS`, but that set is semantically a solver-id set (matched against `solver_id` in `solver_arm`). Serialized records carry only `spec` (=prompt_id) and `case_id`, never `solver_id`, so the two exclusion mechanisms agree only because `code-review-verify`'s prompt id equals its solver id. A future polarity-free entry that is a per-case `criterion` (where `solver_id != prompt_id`) would be excluded on the live path but silently retained-and-scored on the recheck path, reintroducing the very mis-scoring this fix removes.
